story.summary: Coach alleged to have been paid for advisory workHe also claims the club is ‘not guilty’ despite verdictRoberto Mancini appeared to admit having “a double contract” while managing Manchester City, but insisted the club are not guilty after being found to have breached ­Premier League financial rules.Mancini led City to their first ­Premier League title in 2012 during his four-year spell in Manches
